'''SV Austria Salzburg''' is an Austrian professional [[association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Salzburg]]. The club was formed in 2005 by some supporters of the original SV (Austria) Salzburg after it was renamed [[FC Red Bull Salzburg]] by its new owners, who also changed the club's colours from its traditional violet and white to red and white. 

The club started participation in the seventh tier of Austria's national league system in 2006, then rose through four successive championships to the third tier, [[Austrian Regional League|Regionalliga West]], in 2010. In 2015, the club gained promotion to the [[Austrian Football First League|Erste Liga]], one tier below the [[Austrian Bundesliga]], only to be relegated a year later.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.bundesliga.at/index.php?id=577525|title=SV Austria Salzburg feiert den Aufstieg in die Sky Go Erste Liga |date=29 May 2015|language=de|work=Österreichische Fußball-Bundesliga}}</ref> Austria currently competes in [[2. Liga (Austria)|Austrian Second League]] in the 2025–26 season, after promotion from [[Austrian Regionalliga]] in 2024–25."}}
